facts.text: The hotel has a central yet secluded location just steps from St Mark's Square and the Rialto Bridge.
facts.excerpt: With its central yet secluded location, just steps from iconic **St Mark's Square** and the **Rialto Bridge**

facts.text: The hotel is within walking distance of Saint Mark's Square in one direction and the Rialto Bridge in the other.
facts.excerpt: Within walking distance of Saint Mark's Square in one direction and Rialto Bridge in the other

facts.text: The hotel has a private dock for gondolas and water taxis.
facts.excerpt: a private dock for gondolas and **water taxis**

facts.text: The hotel's interiors blend rich colors, precious fabrics and design pieces.
facts.excerpt: the hotel boasts a beautiful blend of rich colors, precious fabrics and design pieces

facts.text: Splendid Venice traces its roots to the 16th century, when part of it formed the Black Hat Inn.
facts.excerpt: Splendid Venice can trace its roots all the way to the 16th century, when part of it formed the Black Hat Inn

facts.text: The lobby is a succession of small Levantine parlors.
facts.excerpt: the lobby, rather than transitioning into a modern, open design, is a succession of small Levantine parlors

facts.text: Rooms are decorated in silver, brown and lilac, with wallpapers and damask designs that evoke Venice's textile tradition.
facts.excerpt: Silver, brown and lilac set the tone, with wallpapers and damask designs that evoke the Serenissima’s textile tradition

facts.text: Several rooms have balconies and views over St Mark's.
facts.excerpt: several with balconies and views over St Mark’s

facts.text: The Presidential Suite has a double private terrace with views of Saint Mark's.
facts.excerpt: With a double private terrace and unparalleled Saint Mark's views, our largest suite

facts.text: The Presidential Suite's private double terrace looks out over the Campanile and the city's rooftops.
facts.excerpt: with a private double terrace, with a view of the Campanile and the city's rooftops

facts.text: The Splendid Heritage Suites are a tribute to Venice's textile tradition, each with a bedroom and a separate sitting area.
facts.excerpt: A tribute to the Serenissima’s textile tradition, each Splendid Heritage Suite measures 40 square meters and offers absolute privacy and ultimate comfort, with a spacious bedroom and a separate sitting area

facts.text: Deluxe Canal View rooms have details recalling classic Venetian style and canal views.
facts.excerpt: A spacious sanctuary for your vacation in Venice with details that recall classic Venetian style and wonderful canal views

facts.text: The Altana is a traditional Venetian rooftop terrace on top of the hotel serving cocktails and wine with views.
facts.excerpt: located on top of the Splendid Venice's roof, our altana - the quintessential Venetian rooftop terrace - is an exclusive location to take in breathtaking views while savoring a perfectly crafted cocktail, a glass of wine

facts.text: On summer evenings the rooftop Altana offers a mixologist experience for aperitifs.
facts.excerpt: In the summer evenings, enjoy the mixologist experience on our panoramic rooftop Altana

facts.text: Le Maschere restaurant, led by Venice-born Executive Chef Massimo Livan, serves Venetian-inspired dishes focused on fresh local fish.
facts.excerpt: Helmed by **Executive Chef** **Massimo Livan**, a celebrated Venice-born chef, the restaurant offers a sophisticated yet authentic cuisine that tells the essence of the lagoon, enhancing the freshest local fish

facts.text: The Lounge Bar has large picture windows looking onto the canal, where gondolas glide by.
facts.excerpt: With its large picture windows, the Splendid Venice Lounge Bar is the ideal place to take a break and gaze lazily around at the magnificent views of the canal, where the gondolas silently slide by

facts.text: The hotel's craft experiences include a visit to an authentic Murano glass factory at Berengo Studio.
facts.excerpt: Step into an authentic Murano glass factory and discover the magic of glass as it takes shape before your eyes, coaxed by master artisans

facts.text: Guests can make their own Venetian papier-mache mask at Ca' Macana as one of the hotel's craft experiences.
facts.excerpt: Make your very own Venetian papier-mâché mask, ready to wear for the next Carnival ball

facts.text: The Family Connecting Room is designed for families travelling with children.
facts.excerpt: Ideal for families travelling with kids, the Family Room offers an abundance of space for your Venice getaway

facts.text: Splendid Venice is part of Preferred Hotels & Resorts.
facts.excerpt: Splendid Venice - Starhotels Collezione is part of Preferred Hotels & Resorts

facts.text: Splendid Venice won Conde Nast Traveler Readers' Choice Awards in 2018, 2021, 2022 and 2023.
facts.excerpt: Readers' Choice Awards 2018, 2021, 2022, 2023
